outcome: Treatment failure within 7 days after extubation
Reintubation rates within 7 days after extubation
cohort: The study included 175 extremely low birth weight infants undergoing first extubation, who received either NIPPV or NHFOV as non-invasive respiratory support.
finding: In extremely low birth weight infants, NHFOV resulted in a significantly lower rate of treatment failure within 7 days after extubation compared to NIPPV.
